title: Jain Friendly Italian Tempeh Carbonara
description: A tangy and tender Italian dish featuring tempeh, marinated in a Jain-friendly way, served in a Korean brass bowl, perfect as a hangover cure.

ingredients.name: kala namak
ingredients.notes: Indian black salt for eggy flavor

instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the spaghetti according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat some oil over medium heat and saute the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the tempeh to the skillet and cook until golden brown, then set aside.
In the same skillet, add the marinara sauce, nutritional yeast, kala namak, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the cooked tempeh back into the skillet and toss to coat with the sauce.
Drain the spaghetti and add it to the skillet, tossing everything together.
Transfer the carbonara to a Korean brass bowl and serve immediately.
Garnish with some chopped fresh parsley or basil, if desired.
This dish is best consumed fresh, but leftovers can be stored in the refrigerator for up to a day.
